tradition_assertions.notes: The exact TEI title and its Epistle note support a provisional Romans link to the Church list. The source text is stated to come from a printed EOTC Bible, but the physical exemplar and recension are unidentified; its chapter divisions are described as preliminary.

witness.title: Beta maṣāḥǝft LIT3515Epistle TEI text
witness.date_statement: Source file pinned at Works commit ec53d3f4c5de47e463fa56a8465cf1090316a999; exact print-exemplar date unknown
witness.editorial_policy: The TEI identifies the epistle text as taken from a printed EOTC Bible and describes its 16 manuscript-present chapter divisions as preliminary, without accounting for recensions. The exact printed exemplar and recension are not identified; unchanged XML is retained alongside the display extraction.

coverage.structure_description: The reader retains all 495 TEI line elements (430 numbered, 65 unnumbered), six surrounding unsegmented ab elements, the heading-only Introduction marker, and both source notes. Its 16 explicit chapter divisions are preliminary per the source. This is completeness for the captured TEI scope only, not the printed exemplar or any recension.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: Whitespace normalized for display; inline markup flattened while unchanged TEI is retained. Source labels and the source's preliminary division are preserved without normalization.
coverage.numbering_policy: Preserve every TEI source n label exactly; retain all unnumbered lines and surrounding text parts in order. Do not treat navigational text-part order as verse numbering.

rights.statement: The TEI file states CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribute Beta maṣāḥǝft, link source and license, identify extraction and whitespace normalization, and share adaptations alike. The file-level license does not establish rights in the unidentified printed exemplar.

rights.territory_or_term_limits: The file-level license applies to the TEI file and its adaptation; do not infer rights in the unidentified printed source.
